scores.evidence: Re-scored because check-quiz e1 changed. The objectives did not change. e1 keeps objectiveId o1 and bloom apply, and it is still a transfer item (sharing a new skill with a team). The rename does not affect alignment. Options b, a and d still differ only in place (`~/.claude/skills/api/SKILL.md` vs `.claude/skills/api/SKILL.md`) or in form (`.claude/skills/api.md`), so the item still tests scope and folder shape. o1 has q2, q3, e1 and e2. o2 has q1, q5, q6 and e3. o3 has q4, e5 and e6. The create level of o1 is still checked only through the practice (pr-write, pr-checklist).

hook-b1 sets a concrete problem in 3 sentences (「コミットの前に、毎回同じ手順をClaude Codeに貼り付けていませんか。」), and the ungraded hook-q leads into 7-1. hook-q mostly asks learners to recall lesson 6, though (its explanation says 「（第6回）」). The second problem in hook-b1, research output flooding the conversation, gets no prediction.

The prerequisites name lessons 5 and 6, and the text recalls them where they matter (「（第6回）」 in s1-lead and hook-q, 「（第5回）」 in s3-lead). New terms are defined with their English before use: s1-defs (スキル, フロントマター, 段階的な読み込み), s3-defs (サブエージェント, フォーク) and s4-lead (拡張機能). The definitions match the glossary, and YAML is explained inline.

measure.mjs reports 「prose 2183 (budget 1,200–2,400) · read 2610 · practice reading 931 · questions 12 · practice sections 1 · est 17.9 min (must be ≤ 20; estMinutes 18)」, the same as last round, because option text is not counted as prose. lint --strict reports 0 errors and 0 warnings. The prose is still near the top of the budget, and 7-3 is still the densest section (s3-defs, s3-bg, s3-file-lead and s3-file come before its check).

7-2 is a full worked example that comes before the practice. ex-description states what `>-` does (「長い説明文は、`>-` のあとで改行し、同じ幅で字下げして続けると、1つの説明文になります。」), and the other steps give their reasons. There is no faded example, and the subagent half of the practice is modelled only by s3-how and s3-file.

Each of the 4 content sections ends with an inline quiz (s1-check to s4-check), and every wrong option has feedback. q5 (fork vs ordinary subagent) and q6 (four situations mapped to their triggers) need application, not word matching. One weakness: q2's answer is the key that s2-invoke names just before it.

Re-scored because check-quiz e1 changed. Each e1 distractor still names a real misconception, and its feedback is unchanged and still fits the new paths. b, the personal scope, gets 「ホームフォルダのスキルは、自分のすべてのプロジェクトで使う個人用です。」. d, a flat file with no folder (`.claude/skills/api.md`), gets 「スキルは、名前のフォルダの中に置いた `SKILL.md` です。」. c, CLAUDE.md, gets 「使わない日も毎回全文が読み込まれます」. The other misconceptions from the brief are still covered by q1 a, q2 b, q4 c, q5 b, e2 a, q6 d, e6 b and s4-pitfall.

s1-diagram (5 nodes) and s3-diagram (4 nodes) show a process, and their captions state the takeaway (「読んだ中身はサブエージェント側に残り、メインの会話には要約だけが戻る」). There are no decorative images. The s1-diagram alt describes a branch the diagram does not draw (「それ以外では本文は読み込まれない」), and that branch is the contrast q1 tests.

The task is authentic: the learner turns their own repeated work into a skill, then compares `/context` before and after delegating. All 7 pr-steps have an expect, pr-checklist sets 5 success criteria, and pr-model and pr-model-lead give a model answer with its reason. It is not a 4, because pr-write has only one hint rung (「7-2の `commit-message` を手本に、中身を入れ替えます。」) before the model answer.

summary-points (4 points) comes after the exam. summary-next has a reflection specific to this lesson (「スキルにしたい手順と、サブエージェントに任せたい調べものを1つずつ挙げてみましょう」) and names the next lesson by its exact title. Then come 6 flashcards and 3 askTutor suggestions.

Re-scored because check-quiz e1 changed. The new paths are correct and consistent. `.claude/skills/api/SKILL.md` follows the layout the explanation states (「プロジェクトの `.claude/skills/<名前>/SKILL.md`」), the same layout s2 uses for `commit-message`. `api` is a valid skill name made of lowercase letters only. check-quiz still cites cc-skills. Not a 4, for reasons unchanged from last round: q5 and summary-cards present `/subtask` without the agent-view condition in commands.md, and [repro-yaml] was run on 2.1.306 while the lesson pins v2.1.304.

The text uses です・ます and is warm (「まず予想してみましょう」, 「見比べてみましょう」). lint --strict finds no banned phrases or overlong sentences. Katakana terms carry their English on first use. The s1-diagram verb 「読む」 against 「読み込まれる」 in the text remains; the brief says it is intentional. The ja-editor owns the wording.

The change removes the mid-name wrap that visual-qa found at 390 px: the longest chip is now `~/.claude/skills/api/SKILL.md` (28 characters) instead of `~/.claude/skills/api-guide/SKILL.md` (34). niceToHave: pr-steps pr-after: the hint says the difference 「決まります」 with no hedge, while the expect, pr-c5 and e6 c all say 主に. Suggested text: 「差は、サブエージェントが読んだファイルの量ではなく、主に依頼文と報告の長さで決まります。報告に挙がったファイルの数と見比べてみましょう。」 (wording: ja-editor).
pr-write: add a middle hint rung before the model answer: 「説明文は「〜する。〜のときに使う。」の2文で、本文は①②③の番号つきの手順で書きます。」
hook-predict: add a second ungraded prediction for the other problem in hook-b1, e.g. 「Claudeにサブエージェントで40個のファイルを読んでもらうと、メインの会話には何が残ると思いますか？」

s1-diagram: draw the 「いいえ」 branch if the width allows (`D -.->|それ以外| F[本文は
読み込まない]`); otherwise add the contrast to the caption, because q1 tests it.

s2-check q2: the answer is the key that s2-invoke names just before it. To make it less of a recall item, ask which of three skills (deploy-prod, summarize-changes, test-report) should get `disable-model-invocation: true`.
s3-file-lead: `tools: Read, Grep, Glob` is not explained, but e6 d relies on it (「読み取り用にしぼっていた」). Change the end to 「`tools` でツールをしぼれます（例は、読み取りと検索だけ）。」
s4-check q6: the prompt asks 「次の困りごとのうち」, but option d begins 「まだ困っていないが」. Consider 「次の場面のうち、スキルにするのがいちばん合うのはどれでしょう？」 (wording: ja-editor).

factual doubt: commands.md says 「When agent view is turned off, `/subtask` isn't available and `/fork` spawns the forked subagent instead」. q5 and summary-cards present `/subtask` without that condition. Consider a short note in s3-defs or a troubleshoot entry.
